chunk_list: NEXUS ADMINISTRATIVE OPERATIONS HANDBOOK V2.0 1. Purpose This handbook brings together common NEXUS operating procedures for travel, minor purchases, budgeting, recruitment, visitors, training, inventory, rooms, administrative filing, and project closure. Its purpose is to reduce informal decisions and ensure that every case retains owners, dates, and evidence. The handbook does not replace institutional policies of Sierra Centro Public University. Where a difference exists, the current university rule prevails. Annexes and forms are reviewed periodically and retain a relation to their earlier version. 2. Responsibilities Clara Ibáñez Soto coordinates LabOps and budget monitoring. Rosa Mena Ortiz maintains cases, travel, onboarding, and filing. Nuria Castaño Rey manages infrastructure and technical inventory. Project leads validate scientific purpose and cost allocation. Every procedure distinguishes the requester, reviewer, approver, and executor.

One person must not approve their own expense where institutional rules require separation. Decisions and exceptions are recorded in writing. 3. Principles Operations follow necessity, proportionality, traceability, separation of duties, least access, and limited retention. An email or chat may initiate an action, but the case must contain the required form, approval, and evidence. Operating procedure 1 Procedure 1, travel, covers request, authorization, booking, advances, expense reporting, and closure. Every case has an identifier, purpose, project, owner, dates, status, and documents. Statuses are draft, awaiting information, under review, approved, rejected, and closed. Non-applicable fields are explicitly marked. Conditional approval states what is missing and when it expires. Closure includes a check that no actions, advances, or access remain open.
